title: BYD iOS Localized · Public beta
description: Try the free BYD iOS localization beta in English, Arabic or Russian. Install through AltStore Classic and customize your bottom tabs. No jailbreak required.
intro_html: The Chinese BYD iPhone app in English, العربية and Русский, with the bottom tabs you want to see. Free to try, with no jailbreak required.
setup_note_html: AltStore Classic must already be installed and configured. Open this page in Safari on your iPhone. Initial setup requires a Mac or Windows computer and your own Apple account.
screenshots_note: Actual iPhone screenshots. Tap an image to view it full size.
dashboard_alt: English My Car dashboard with Bluetooth badges on Lock, Windows, Engine Off, Trunk and AC
english_alt: Language selector offering English, Arabic and Russian, with English selected
tabs_alt: Arabic bottom-bar settings with separate switches for Discover, Mall and Service
russian_alt: Russian language selector with Russian selected
setup_intro_html: Already have AltStore Classic? Continue to the next step. Otherwise, install AltServer on your computer and use it to install AltStore Classic on your iPhone. Use your own Apple account; no paid developer membership is required. Enable Developer Mode on iOS 16 or later.
video_note: The videos explain AltStore setup. Screens and steps may differ by version; use the current official guides if needed:
install_one_html: Tap Add to AltStore Classic above and confirm adding the source.
install_two_html: Find BYD Localized in AltStore, review permissions and install with your own Apple account.
install_three_html: Open BYD and sign in to your own BYD account. Go to Me → Settings to choose your language and bottom tabs.
update_html: Already installed? Refresh the source in AltStore, then choose Update for BYD under My Apps. Look for 9.16.0 · Revision 2. Keep your existing app and use the same Apple account to preserve its local data.
refresh_html: Keep AltServer running and reachable over the same Wi-Fi network or USB when installing, updating or refreshing. With a free Apple account, refresh both AltStore and BYD before their seven-day signing period expires. The download is about 339 MB; speed depends on your connection to GitHub.
source_label_html: If the button does not open AltStore, add this URL under Browse → Sources → +:
copy_fallback: Select and copy the URL above.
impactor_html: Download the IPA and import it into Impactor. On the package options screen, change Name from the Chinese text to BYD, then sign and install with your own Apple account.
impactor_note_html: If you see Developer API error 35 about a missing appIdName, set Name to BYD and retry with the same IPA. Keep the default identifier and app-group handling. Downloading an IPA alone does not install it.
feature_one: Choose English, Arabic or Russian in Settings.
feature_two: Hide Discover, Mall and Service individually.
feature_three: Find My Car by its original car icon.
features_note: Fully close and reopen BYD after changing language. Tab visibility changes immediately; My Car and Me remain available.
status_text: Revision 2 restores Bluetooth badges on supported dashboard controls. It has installed and launched through AltStore Classic on a non-jailbroken iPhone XS. The maintainer also reports successful testing on several other iPhones; broader feedback is welcome.
status_note: Requires iOS 15 or later; not every device or vehicle function has been tested. Some Chinese content and artwork remain. The profile page may be blank. Wakeup unlock is not included yet.
footer_text: Unofficial project, not affiliated with or endorsed by BYD. BYD’s original application and assets belong to their respective owners. Apple-restricted capabilities such as Wallet car keys, push notifications and Siri integration are not promised for this sideloaded build. This is an AltStore Classic source, not an AltStore PAL listing.
